extensionDescription.message: Connect Chrome to W1 automatically. Let your assistant find the right page, with pause controls always available.

waitingDescription.message: Open W1 to connect automatically. Your assistant will find and use the right page.

connectedDescription.message: Ask W1 to work in Chrome. It will choose the right tab or open a new page.

pausedDescription.message: Browser access is paused. Enable the connection whenever you want to continue.

scope.message: Ordinary web pages are available automatically. Incognito and browser-internal pages are excluded. Pause any page below.

footer.message: Page actions are initiated by your W1 tasks

update.message: W1 connection service needs an update

updateDescription.message:
A local service responded but is not ready for this connection protocol.
Quit W1 from its menu and reopen the normal shortcut. No port setup is needed.
